checked_profile.summary: Private education borrowing with payment options that differ for cosigned and independent applications.
checked_profile.scope: This check covers enrollment, repayment options and grace-period conditions in Earnest’s help center. It does not confirm an APR, minimum credit score, fee schedule or universal cosigner-release timeline.

facts.label: Enrollment
facts.text: Earnest’s private-loan guidance does not require a completed degree from the student or parent. The student must be enrolled at least half-time in an undergraduate or graduate degree program.

facts.label: Cosigned versus independent
facts.text: Earnest lists deferred and fixed $25 payments for both cosigned and independent loans. Its interest-only and full principal-and-interest options are listed for cosigned loans only.

facts.label: Grace-period conditions
facts.text: The nine-month grace period does not apply to the full-repayment option. Leaving school or dropping below half-time starts the grace period for other options; accrued interest may be added to principal when full repayment begins.

questions: Which repayment options are available with my application and cosigner?
